ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Sponsor sales, Prospect and later stages need Sponsor objectives.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "Sponsor_sales", CASE(StageName, "Prospect", 1, "Meeting held", 2, "Proposal sent", 3, "Negotiating", 4, "Contract out", 5, "Signed", 6, 0) >= 1, ISBLANK(Sponsor_objectives__c))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Sponsor objectives before moving to Prospect.
